info.title: JudyTik Cloud Foundation API
info.description: DESIGN CONTRACT only. No live backend/DB/provider is configured. Cloud preset ownership, PKCE-brokered native auth, session rotation and optimistic concurrency. Secret-bearing endpoints are main-process only. See the architecture spec for semantic checks and policies.

servers.description: Production origin placeholder; never a real credential/deployment.

get.description: Does not return database addresses, versions, environment or secrets.

post.summary: Create a PKCE-bound Desktop sign-in attempt
post.description: Limit 10/min/IP. Redirect URI must be exactly 127.0.0.1, port 1024–65535 and /oauth/callback, with no credentials/query/fragment. No network call to the supplied URI.

get.summary: Show browser confirmation for a Desktop sign-in attempt
get.description: This is an authentication broker page, not the sales website. Does not automatically authorize an unconfirmed attempt.

200.description: Minimal server-rendered confirmation; HTML-escaped device label, session-bound CSRF token and secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax browser cookie.

post.summary: Confirm browser intent and redirect to the selected provider
post.description: Require matching browser CSRF token/cookie and an unexpired attempt. Redact form/token values from logs.

302.description: Server-generated Google/Discord authorize URL; state bound to attempt and browser session.

get.summary: Consume provider callback and issue one-time Desktop code
get.description: Validate/consume OAuth state atomically, browser binding and provider identity proof. Exactly one of code/error is allowed. Never merge identities solely by matching email. Ignore documented provider-specific auxiliary query fields; reject duplicate state/code/error and enforce exactly one of code/error before any exchange.

302.description: Redirect to the exact stored loopback URI, with code/client state or a safe error/client state. No session tokens in URL.

post.summary: Cancel a sign-in attempt with proof of its PKCE verifier
post.description: Cancel and grant exchange lock the same attempt row. Verify PKCE proof first. If cancellation wins, mark cancelled atomically and invalidate any issued but unconsumed grant; token exchange and later callbacks must reject it. If exchange already consumed the grant, return 409 AUTH_ATTEMPT_ALREADY_CONSUMED rather than claiming cancellation; cancelling an attempt is not session logout.

204.description: Attempt cancelled or already cancelled; any unconsumed grant is invalid.

409.description: AUTH_ATTEMPT_ALREADY_CONSUMED: exchange won. Main must log out if credentials were received and the user still wants to cancel; an ambiguous exchange is not proof that a session was revoked.

post.summary: Exchange a one-use code or rotate a refresh token
post.description: Consume code/refresh in an atomic transaction. Authorization-code exchange locks the attempt row, checks cancelledAt is null, attempt and grant expiry, PKCE, redirect URI and unused grant before creating a session and consuming the grant atomically. Cancel and exchange serialize on this row; cancelled grants return 401. Refresh reuse revokes that session family. Do not blindly retry an exchange after an ambiguous network failure.

200.description: Desktop session credentials for main process only.

post.summary: Revoke current session and its refresh family

204.description: Revoked. Main must also clear local credentials.

get.summary: Read server-computed effective plan and expiry

200.description: Effective plan, not a client-writable capability.

get.summary: List sessions belonging to this account

delete.summary: Revoke one of the current account sessions

post.summary: Request a one-use email verification challenge
post.description: Production code is random, 6 digits, TTL 10 min, HMAC stored, max 5 guesses. At least 60 sec between sends; 3/15 min/account and 10/hour/IP. One active challenge per user. No fixed mockup code accepted.

202.description: Generic acceptance; does not disclose whether email belongs to another account.

post.summary: Consume a valid email code and update verified email
post.description: Challenge must belong to authenticated user, be active/unexpired and have attempts remaining. Never reassign an email already verified by another account.

put.summary: Replace settings using a strong revision precondition

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong ETag from the last read. Required for updates/deletes/settings. Missing precondition returns 428; stale returns 412.

get.summary: Read a stable paginated Cloud preset snapshot
get.description: With after, collectionRevision is required. Read revision+rows in a RepeatableRead transaction. Changed revision returns 409 PRESET_COLLECTION_CHANGED; restart from page one. Never replace cache with a partial snapshot.

200.description: Visible own presets only, UUID ascending.

get.summary: Read an own preset and its ETag

put.summary: Create or replace one Cloud preset
put.description: Exactly one precondition: If-None-Match:* for creation; strong If-Match for replacement. Missing=428, both=400, stale/existing=412. Owner comes from session. Lock own users row then mutate preset, revision, collection revision and audit atomically. Never execute a stored effect. On ambiguous save outcome, read/compare before deciding whether to retry.

delete.summary: Soft-delete one own preset with a strong revision precondition

204.description: Tombstone saved. Public reads now return 404.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Strong ETag from the last read. Required for updates/deletes/settings. Missing precondition returns 428; stale returns 412.

get.summary: Open the selected provider directly with a one-use native launch capability
get.description: The HMAC capability is bound to the attempt, PKCE challenge, state, exact loopback and expiry. Browser cookie and provider state remain separate. No account tokens in this URL. Legacy consent flow remains available separately.

302.description: Set signed HttpOnly browser binding and redirect to the provider.

200.description: Account Soundpad document; revision 0 is the unsaved empty default.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Quoted current revision, including "0" for the first save.

200.description: Account Soundpad document; revision 0 is the unsaved empty default.

412.description: SOUNDPAD_VERSION_CONFLICT; keep local edits and explicitly reload.

200.description: Account TTS settings only; queue, chats and installed voices remain local. Revision 0 is the unsaved default.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Quoted current revision; use "0" for initial save.

200.description: Account TTS settings only; queue, chats and installed voices remain local. Revision 0 is the unsaved default.

412.description: TTS_VERSION_CONFLICT; retain local edits and explicitly reload.

200.description: Account Overlay settings only; LIVE events, queues and animation state remain local. Revision 0 is the unsaved default.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Quoted current revision; use "0" for initial save.

200.description: Account Overlay settings only; LIVE events, queues and animation state remain local. Revision 0 is the unsaved default.

412.description: OVERLAY_VERSION_CONFLICT; retain local edits and explicitly reload.

put.summary: Save account Overlay settings with optimistic concurrency

desktopSession.description: Access token held by Electron main. Backend also checks active session and ownership.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag from the last read. Required for updates/deletes/settings. Missing precondition returns 428; stale returns 412.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: Required when creating a preset with a client-generated UUID.

BadRequest.description: Malformed or semantically invalid input; unknown properties are rejected.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked access session. OAuth token errors use the same safe envelope.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated account cannot perform this capability.

NotFound.description: Missing/deleted resource or a resource belonging to another account; no ownership disclosure.

Conflict.description: Collection changed, deleted preset UUID reused or an identity/email ownership conflict.

PreconditionFailed.description: Preset/settings revision conflict. Draft must be preserved; no automatic overwrite.

PreconditionRequired.description: A strong write precondition is required.

Unavailable.description: Dependency unavailable or provider not configured. No internal error/secret is returned.

authorizationUrl.description: HTTPS URL on the configured Backend origin. Main validates the origin/path before opening the system browser.

Tokens.description: Main process only. Never return these fields through renderer IPC or URLs.

Entitlements.description: Effective plan is computed by Backend from unrevoked time-bounded grants. Clients cannot write this resource.

MediaBinding.description: Device-local binding reference. No absolute path is sent to Cloud. A different device must resolve or remap it before execution.

body.description: JSON object, not executable code. Backend stores but never fetches a URL when a preset is saved.

giftId.description: Canonical catalog ID (Rose is 5655), or '*' for all gifts. Empty for non-gift triggers.

threshold.description: Gift/like event count; for fanclub, minimum TikTok fan-club level (inclusive), evaluated per event without accumulation.

likeScope.description: Like threshold scope; omitted values count separately per viewer.

PresetWrite.description: Maximum HTTP request body 256 KiB. Validate unique action IDs and semantic effect constraints in addition to this JSON Schema. No owner/plan/revision fields are writable.

examples.name: คุยกับคนดู

effects.template: ขอบคุณ {username} สำหรับ Rose × {count}

enabled.description: When omitted, Soundpad is enabled for existing saved documents.

blockedWords.description: Custom words or phrases in any language, without entry-count or phrase-length limits. The complete HTTP request remains limited to 256 KiB.

likerLimit.description: Top Likers rows; omitted legacy setting displays Top 10.

SliderItem.description: Slider caption plus optional HTTPS gift image or local image binding. Local paths are never stored.
